nodes.title: Owner, 2026-11-10: 'This codebase is entirely yours: what it's for and how it's built are your call, and you'll keep building on it. We are revolutionizing education and learning with this product.' The main loop decides product direction and architecture, records each decision in context/ with its reversal condition, and keeps building. Still the owner's: money (ask before high Azure usage, buy nothing), the owner's accounts and keys, deleting anything on Azure, anything involving real children or families, and taste choices the owner has asked to make (Asha's look). Direction taken by the main loop under it: a teacher that knows the child in front of her and makes what that child needs next, every answer checked against a verified key; after director18 the main effort moves from the four pilot lessons to closing the learner loop (learner state changes what is taught) and wiring the approval step so generated content can reach a child, with scripted teaching scaled in judged batches and round 7 released. Reverse if the owner says otherwise.
